name: Home
notes: Round house with the map wall.

name: Woodland Mansion
notes: Big dark-oak mansion in the roofed forest. Seen again from (-2928, 398). Dangerous: evokers/vindicators inside.

name: Pillager Outpost
notes: Outpost tower next to a dark-oak building. Pillagers with crossbows — bring armor. Allays may be caged nearby.

name: Sulfur springs
notes: Sulfur springs (new-update feature) in the forest. Sulfur to collect.

name: Big ravine + waterfalls
notes: Deep open ravine with several waterfalls, exposed stone layers and a cave mouth at the bottom. Good ore hunting.

name: Sulfur springs (bottom)
notes: Looking down into the bottom of a second sulfur springs — the pale sparkly stuff is sulfur, not diamonds.

name: Sandstone cliff
notes: Tall sandstone/sand cliff face dropping to the water. Easy sandstone and sand.

name: Stone mountain
notes: Bare stone/gravel peaks with terraces. Stone, gravel, coal; watch for drops.

name: Longhorn cows
notes: Brown long-horned cows by the lake in the taiga. Pen them or lead with wheat.

name: Woodland tent
notes: Little woodland tent structure from the poplar-tree update: white canopy, birch posts, hay bales, chest. The explorer/treasure map came from here.

name: Explorer map found near here
notes: Holding the explorer/treasure map here, just after finding it in the woodland tent to the north. Come back here when ready to use it.

name: Deepslate spire
notes: Tall cobbled-deepslate spike on a hill — looks like a marker someone placed. Unknown what it marks; worth poking around.
